title: Length bound for a nonempty list prefix
statement: Let $E,s,$ and $r$ be bit lists and let $p$ be a natural number. If dropping the first $p$ entries of $E$ gives the concatenation of $s$ and $r$, and $s$ is nonempty, then $p+|s|\le |E|$.
hypotheses_covered: Dropping the first $p$ entries of $E$ yields $s$ followed by $r$
